df9d1a5a134299c4.justification: Ile67Asn is a specific single-amino-acid substitution in SNAP25.

3b4665871c30a114.justification: Inhibited exocytosis describes reduced SNAP25 function without establishing interference with the normal protein.

e5aad152daec11b6.justification: SNAP25B names the mutant protein causing the manifestations, not a disease entity.

84e0568a991515dc.justification: None of the candidates represents myasthenia; hypotonia is not equivalent to muscle weakness.

0a2939fa45ecbcb2.justification: None of the candidate phenotypes represents cortical hyperexcitability.
